initial: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: standalone emblem for Perihelion, a polished Minecraft client with a dark, detailed black-hole main menu, warm copper/ivory highlights and restrained custom geometric lettering. Create ONE original, tasteful symbol on a genuinely transparent square canvas, no text or letters. Core metaphor: perihelion / closest approach, a light ribbon pulled inward around a void. Design a strong asymmetric closed-loop crescent with one inward-folded tapered tip and a precise negative-space central aperture; one sculpted, continuous orbital form with a confident distinctive silhouette. It should suggest gravity and motion through shape alone, not a literal illustration of a planet. Minimal flat vector-like artwork, solid near-black ink, clear thick-to-thin rhythm, generous clear space, centered with 20 percent margin. Must still read at 20 px, work as a white watermark, Discord/YouTube avatar or single-color website logo. No stock Saturn planet, no crossing ellipse around a circle, no letter P, no generic camera shutter, no infinity sign, no shields, no esports mascot, no stars or sparkles, no gradients, no glow, no 3D, no mockups, no outlines finer than the main shape. One emblem only.
directions: Use case: logo-brand. Create an art-director's concept sheet for PERIHELION, a refined gaming client with a cinematic copper black-hole theme and clean custom geometric type. Exactly THREE very different standalone emblem explorations, evenly spaced in one horizontal row on a flat warm off-white canvas. Small plain labels A, B, C below, no other text. All emblems solid near-black, flat vector-like, strong negative space, no shading, texture or mockups. This is serious bespoke identity design, not a generic gaming logo. A: a custom P monogram made from a lensing black-hole aperture, where a precise oblique cut of negative space folds through its bowl; the P is subtly discoverable, not a typed P with a circle. B: an eclipsed circular void with two broad asymmetric accretion surfaces, where a diagonal light slit is warped around the core; one compact optical knot, intriguing black-hole silhouette, NOT a ring around a planet. C: an abstract perihelion symbol using an eccentric oblique orbit with a distinct closest-approach pinch and a cropped planar terminal, architectural and optically balanced. Each must have a genuinely different outer silhouette and construction, hold up as a 24px icon and be memorable in monochrome. Absolutely NO spiral curls, wave swirls, hurricanes, numeral 6, letter G, creature heads, flames, esports shields, mascots, camera shutters, generic infinity marks, stock Saturn planets, detached sparkles, gradients, 3D or decorative outlines. Give the shapes enough boldness for a watermark and enough restraint for a premium software identity.
literal: Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE clean, original logo emblem of an unmistakable BLACK HOLE for Perihelion. Solid flat warm ivory artwork centered on a uniform deep charcoal background. The core must be a LARGE EMPTY PERFECT CIRCULAR VOID showing the charcoal background, not a filled sphere, pupil or planet. A precise near-circular photon ring frames this black circular shadow, with a broad horizontal flattened accretion disk crossing only its LOWER THIRD; the far side of the disk is occluded by the central shadow, and a single warped light arc bends up over its top. Reference the physical silhouette of an Interstellar-like gravitationally lensed black hole, reduced to a professional vector icon. Wide low disk, tall circular void. The void must remain clearly circular and dominate the icon. Three purposeful large shapes maximum, generous negative space, deliberate asymmetric ring weight, shortened controlled disk terminals, simple enough for 32px. No almond shapes, no eye contours, no filled circle in center, no mirrored crescents, no swirl, no hurricane, no e or G or 6, no spiral, no lightning slash, no mascot, no stars, no orbiting planet, no decorative pointy spikes, no gradient, no glow, no shading, no 3D. No text, no board, no mockups. Flat serious logo design, clear spare geometry, recognizable black-hole silhouette.
